overview.title: Electoral Strategy - Digital Edition
overview.description: Campaign for the presidency by playing cards to shift state lean and win 270 electoral votes
overview.tooltip: Win by controlling states worth 270+ electoral votes through strategic card play

victory.title: How to Win
victory.description: Be the first player to control states worth 270 or more electoral votes

stateControl.description: A state is controlled when its lean reaches ±7 or more
stateControl.contested: Lean between -6 and +6 means the state is contested (no electoral votes awarded)

victory.tooltip: Control states by shifting their lean to ±7 or more in your direction

steps.title: Create or Join Game
steps.description: Host creates a game and receives a 6-character code. Other players join using this code.
steps.tooltip: Share your game code with other players to let them join

steps.title: Party Assignment
steps.description: When the game starts, players are automatically assigned to Democrat or Republican parties, alternating by turn order.
steps.tooltip: First player becomes Democrat, second becomes Republican, and so on

steps.title: Initial Deal
steps.description: Each player starts with 5 cards drawn randomly from the deck
steps.tooltip: Your starting hand consists of Policy, Campaign, Event, and Special cards

steps.title: Starting State Lean
steps.description: All states begin with their historical lean values based on real electoral data
steps.tooltip: Blue states start with positive lean, red states with negative lean, swing states near 0

turnStructure.title: Your Turn
turnStructure.description: Each turn you can play or discard up to 3 cards

phases.description: The game advances to your turn automatically when the previous player ends their turn
phases.tooltip: Wait for your turn indicator to show it's your turn to play

phases.description: You may play or discard up to 3 cards from your hand

actions.description: Select a card from your hand, choose target states if required, then click 'Play'
actions.tooltip: Some cards auto-target states, others require you to select target states on the map

actions.description: Select a card from your hand and click 'Discard' to remove it without playing
actions.tooltip: Discarding counts as one of your 3 actions per turn

phases.description: When finished, click the 'End Turn' button to pass to the next player

specialCases.effect: All cards in your hand are discarded and you get a fresh hand next turn
specialCases.button: Skip Turn and Redeal All Cards
Skip remaining X actions and end turn

phases.tooltip: After ending your turn, the next player can deal new cards to refill their hand

phases.description: At the start of your turn, click 'Deal Cards' to draw cards until you have 5
phases.tooltip: You must manually deal cards - they won't auto-deal. Newly dealt cards appear on the right side of your hand.

types.description: Your campaign platform positions on key issues
types.effect: Shift state lean based on the card's primary effect
types.targeting: Most Policy cards target specific states or require you to choose states
types.tooltip: Policy cards usually have both a primary effect and potential backlash

types.description: Tactical campaign moves and ground game operations
types.effect: Various effects including state lean shifts, card draws, or special abilities
types.targeting: Varies by card - some auto-target, others require selection
types.tooltip: Campaign cards help you execute your strategy and respond to opponents

types.description: National events that affect all players
types.effect: Can help or hurt all players depending on the event
types.targeting: Usually affects multiple states or all states
types.tooltip: Event cards represent unpredictable national developments

types.effect: Unique effects that can dramatically shift the game
types.tooltip: Special cards are rare and can turn the tide of the campaign

rules.name: Auto-Target Cards
rules.description: These cards automatically apply to their pre-defined target states
rules.userAction: No state selection needed - just click 'Play'
rules.indicator: Card shows target states in its description
rules.tooltip: Auto cards apply immediately without needing to select states

rules.name: Choose One State
rules.description: Select exactly one state from the map to target
rules.userAction: Click one state on the map, then click 'Play'
rules.indicator: Card will show 'Select target state(s) on the map' message
rules.tooltip: Click a single state to target it with this card

rules.name: Choose Multiple States
rules.description: Select multiple states from the map (usually up to 3)
rules.userAction: Click multiple states on the map, then click 'Play'
rules.indicator: Card will show 'Targeting: [selected states]' as you select
rules.tooltip: Click multiple states to target them all with this card

stateLean.title: State Lean System
stateLean.description: Each state has a lean value from -15 to +15 that determines who controls it

scale.description: True swing state - anyone can win

controlThreshold.description: States are controlled when lean reaches ±7 or more
controlThreshold.tooltip: Focus on getting swing states to ±7 to win their electoral votes

electoralVotes.title: Electoral College
electoralVotes.description: Each state has a fixed number of electoral votes based on population
electoralVotes.tooltip: You need 270 of the 538 total electoral votes to win the presidency

rounds.description: The game continues in rounds, with each player taking turns in order
rounds.roundCounter: Track which round you're in via the round indicator
rounds.tooltip: Each complete cycle of all players taking turns is one round

turnOrder.description: Players take turns in the order they joined the game
turnOrder.rotation: Turn order is fixed and rotates clockwise
turnOrder.tooltip: First player goes first every round, then second player, etc.

tips.description: Swing states (PA, MI, WI, AZ, GA, NC, NV) are easier to flip and crucial for victory
tips.tooltip: It's easier to move a swing state from 0 to +7 than a red state from -10 to +7

tips.description: Always know which states you need to reach exactly 270 votes
tips.tooltip: Don't waste actions on states you don't need for victory

tips.description: If your hand is bad, skip your turn to discard all cards and get 5 fresh ones
tips.tooltip: Skipping with 0 actions played gives you a complete new hand next turn

tips.description: Try to use all 3 actions per turn - don't leave value on the table
tips.tooltip: Even discarding a card is better than wasting an action

tips.description: Once you control a state (±7), defend it from opponent's cards
tips.tooltip: Losing a controlled state means losing its electoral votes

elements.description: Shows the distribution of electoral votes by state lean category

colors.leanBlue: Medium blue = Lean Democrat states (+7 to +9)
colors.tiltBlue: Light blue = Tilt Democrat states (+3 to +6)
colors.tiltRed: Light red = Tilt Republican states (-6 to -3)
colors.leanRed: Medium red = Lean Republican states (-9 to -7)

elements.marker: Yellow line shows the 270 electoral vote threshold
elements.tooltip: Quickly see how close you are to 270 electoral votes

elements.description: Interactive map showing all 50 states + DC with current lean values
elements.interaction: Click states to select them when playing cards that require targets
elements.sorting: Grid view can be sorted by: Alphabetical, Lean, Electoral Votes, Swing States, or Region
elements.tooltip: States are colored by their current lean category

elements.description: Your current hand of cards (0-5 cards)
elements.interaction: Click a card to select it, then choose Play or Discard
elements.dealButton: Click 'Deal Cards' when you have < 5 cards to draw more
elements.tooltip: Cards are ordered left-to-right by when they were drawn

states.yourTurn: Green background with 'Select a card to play or [End Turn button]'
states.opponentTurn: Blue background showing which opponent is playing

elements.tooltip: Shows whose turn it is and how many actions remain

elements.description: Shows how many of your 3 actions you have left this turn
elements.tooltip: Resets to 3 at the start of each of your turns

elements.description: Shows the 270 electoral vote threshold needed to win
elements.tooltip: This represents the target you need to reach

quickReference.title: Quick Reference
keyFacts: Control states at ±7 lean or more
3 actions per turn (play or discard cards)
Deal cards manually to refill hand to 5
Skip turn with 0 actions to get new hand
Cards ordered by when drawn (old left, new right)

tooltips.cardCost: Media Points (MP) required to play this card
tooltips.cardEffect: What happens when you play this card
tooltips.backlash: Negative effect that also occurs when playing this card
tooltips.diceMechanic: This card involves a dice roll for variable outcomes
tooltips.electoralVotes: Number of votes this state is worth
tooltips.stateLean: Current lean value - positive favors Democrats, negative favors Republicans
tooltips.leanCategory: How strongly this state leans toward one party
tooltips.selectedCard: Currently selected card - click Play, Discard, or Cancel
tooltips.dealCards: Draw cards from the deck until you have 5 in hand
tooltips.skipTurn: Discard all cards and end turn - you'll get 5 fresh cards next turn
tooltips.endTurn: End your turn and pass to the next player
